how_to_read: 2. .agent-protocol.json - THE rules: zones, gates, contracts, priorities
3. docs/agent-status.json - this file: who is doing what right now

self_service.note: This journal is written through scripts\agent_handoff.py status-set. Every agent writes its OWN section; there is no single-writer owner, because that rule froze the journal whenever its owner was absent.
self_service.shared_lists: hints, history and priorities may be written by any agent
self_service.foreign_section: writing agents.<someone-else>.* is refused with exit code 4; a slot with neither a live claim nor a fresh heartbeat needs --force, a LIVE one also needs --override-live

dashboard.mode: read-only; the UI never writes coordination files
dashboard.not_critical: If it is down, work continues normally.

agent_notes.all_agents_are_ephemeral: Agents appear and disappear. This list is a snapshot, not a roster of permanent owners. Nobody is ever blocked by an entry here: only a live claim on a file blocks that file, and it expires after 90 minutes without a heartbeat.
agent_notes.add_yourself: When you start work, add or update your own agents.<name> section via status-set. If you leave, set your status to DONE - do not delete other agents' sections.

hints.message: Protocol v2.0: ownership is decided by a LIVE CLAIM, not by an agent name. who-owns prints 'СВОБОДНО' when nobody holds the file - just take it. ZONES ARE ADVISORY AND NEVER BLOCK.
A claim expires after 90 minutes without a heartbeat. status marks it '[УСТАРЕЛ — файлы свободны]' and its files can be taken with --force. Never wait for an agent that stopped responding.
docs/agent-status.json is self-service: write your own section with 'status-set agents.<you>.status DONE --agent <you>'. There is no single-writer owner any more.
Rules live ONLY in .agent-protocol.json. .agent-handoff.json holds live state (claims, task_log, hints).
At most 5 agents work at once (claims.max_agents). Check 'status' for live claims before starting a new task; expired claims do not count.

onboarding.note: Paste-ready prompt for any new agent. Contains no agent names on purpose. Adding an agent requires NO protocol edit: pick a name, claim files, work.
